variants.prompt: Marlowe lounges on a colorful beach towel, her barely-there bikini gleaming with metallic accents in the late afternoon sun. Pearls of sweat glisten on her skin as she stretches languidly, one hand drifting down to touch the hem of her bottoms. Her tousled hair frames her face, and her eyes are half-lidded with a sultry, relaxed expression. The shallow depth of field and warm, golden light evoke a sense of sensuality and freedom.
